basic_profile.bio: Hi there! I'm a 26-year-old music enthusiast from Austin, Texas. By day, I'm an IT specialist, but my evenings are filled with strumming my guitar and exploring new music theory concepts. I'm pretty laid-back and love jamming with friends or diving deep into a new tech project. On weekends, you'll find me hiking the local trails or brewing my own kefir. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to explore my passions. I'm usually online in the evenings, especially after 7 PM, when I have some downtime from work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, which has fueled my passion for technology. Music theory is a hobby I've pursued through online courses and self-study, often experimenting with concepts on my guitar. I also dabble in DIY electronics, which led me to explore the Jetson Nano community.
